text: The type A=B in a universe 𝒰 is equivalent to A≃B by univalence. When A=B=ℤ, the type ℤ=ℤ is equivalent to ______.
choices: ℤ≃ℤ (the type of automorphisms of ℤ)
the type of group homomorphisms ℤ→ℤ
answer: ℤ≃ℤ (the type of automorphisms of ℤ)
explanation: By univalence, ℤ=ℤ ≃ ℤ≃ℤ (self-equivalences of ℤ), which corresponds to the automorphism group of ℤ.
